pythonFunction.name: get_pa_options
pythonFunction.description:
Runs the silent hardship triage and returns the payment arrangement plans offered on the account
together with the order in which to present options. Needs an identified caller. Before calling
this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Leave empty: the identified account is used automatically (any other id is refused).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, options (plan_id, term_months, monthly_amount, down_payment_required,
    down_payment_amount), priority_order, arrears, shutoff_date, days_to_shutoff and
    jurisdiction.
